notes: VAT general rate 17.5% (CGI art. 142) plus 10% communal additional centimes = 19.25% effective, confirmed for 2026 by a MINFI/DGI order. The CGI art. 128 exemption list (read in full) contains no gold or precious-metal item, so jewellery and bullion are taxed at the general rate. Import duty HS 7108 null: no official CEMAC tariff page stating the line could be opened.

sources.name: Direction Générale des Impôts - Code Général des Impôts (official edition, updated 1 Jan 2023)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 142 sets the general VAT rate at 17.5%, applicable to all operations not zero-rated; art. 128 exemption list contains no gold item; art. 129(1) subjects all non-exempt operations to VAT
